identificationModule.briefTitle: Ethanol and Cannabinoid Effects on Simulated Driving and Related Cognition: Sub-Study I
identificationModule.officialTitle: Ethanol and Cannabinoid Effects on Simulated Driving and Related Cognition: Sub-Study I

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The overarching goal of this study is to characterize the effects of ethanol and cannabinoids on simulated driving and related cognition.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: To study the effects of oral ethanol (a target BAC of \~0.04 g/dl; equivalent to consuming approximately 2 drinks over 1 hour) and vaporized THC (4 mg of THC dissolved in an ethanolic solution; equivalent to smoking approximately 1/4 of a marijuana cigarette, or "joint") on driving.

conditions: Driving Under the Influence of Alcohol and Other Drugs

interventions.name: Active inhaled delta-9-THC
interventions.description: Low dose THC (\~4 mg), dissolved in alcohol. This dose is roughly equivalent to smoking approximately 1/4 of a marijuana cigarette, or "joint". Administered over 20 minutes via a vaporizer.

interventions.name: Placebo
interventions.description: Control: Approximately 4 drinks of orange juice or ginger ale covered by a trace amount of ethanol on the surface, each administered over approximately 10 minutes.

interventions.name: Placebo
interventions.description: Control: No active THC. Administered over 20 minutes via a vaporizer. approximately 10 minutes.

interventions.name: Active Oral Ethanol
interventions.description: 0.4 g/kg ethanol in orange juice or ginger ale to reach a target BrAC of approximately 0.04%. This dose is equivalent to consuming approximately 2 standard drinks over 1 hour. Approximately 4 drinks, each administered over approximately 10 minutes.

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Males or females 21 to 55 years of age (extremes included).
* Occasional current cannabis users.
* Experience with drinking 2 or more standard drinks of alcohol at least once in lifetime.
* Able to provide informed consent.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Cannabis naïve.
* Alcohol naïve.
* Positive pregnancy screen
* Hearing deficits.
